findings.title: Final async authority fence checks mutable scope before the last await
findings.trigger: A last awaited revalidate/materiality/authorizeBinding/issueWorkRef callback mutates call.binding or aborts the request while returning an otherwise successful result. Existing digest/request checks have already run.
findings.static_result: The path can return ok/comparable under a scope different from the one that authorized its captured data.
findings.required_change: Complete all asynchronous checks first, then synchronously compare the captured call kind/binding, request abort and relevant request/selection/producer snapshot identities immediately before return. Freeze/copy callback-exposed values or check fingerprints after final callbacks.
findings.verification: STATIC_ONLY; root assigned recall agent materiality/outcome/domain and signals agent list/work plus related registry paths.

findings.title: Historical content change can incorrectly reuse a cache envelope when numeric identity is unchanged
findings.trigger: Start with the existing fresh changed-projection test. Use historical + nonempty differences; change record projectionDigest but retain same subject/version/incarnation and previous/current scope. Equivalent changed bytes exist for document blob/segment or case-event outputDigest.
findings.static_result: sameReferenceSubject passes. The fresh guard is bypassed. changedImmutable excludes numeric refs. Version/incarnation maps and scope are identical, so no reason is produced and status becomes reuse.
findings.required_change: Changed historical material content must invalidate with a specific reason such as source-content, or be unavailable if continuity cannot be established. Fresh changed material content stays unavailable. Preserve legitimate currently authorized scoped record reissue with unchanged content and authority-scope invalidation.
findings.verification: STATIC_ONLY; root explicitly accepted and is correcting this file/test.

findings.title: Finite operands can produce nonfinite outcome delta
findings.trigger: Set choice selected metric value and observation.expected to -1e308, observation.observed to 1e308; preserve compatible unit/currency/period/coverage. All current operand checks pass.
findings.static_result: Subtraction produces Infinity, but the result is labeled comparable. The published WP07 validOutcomeComparison rejects such a delta downstream; direct WP14 consumers can receive an invalid comparable result.
findings.required_change: Guard Number.isFinite(observation.observed - value.value) before emitting comparable; return unavailable without changing the baseline, formula or financial policy.
findings.verification: STATIC_ONLY; root forwarded the guard to the author. Inherited issue, not introduced by the clock-normalization delta.
